t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Bútru mua asia Béra caira cawabamanea Béra zhi biara jaraita. Mũa jaraya jõmaũa Bũ ne ẽaba mũa o be ẽa. Béra wárinu obeya. Mùra zhi supuriata Béra shi wai bua bara buta. Béra Caragabia tewara ne ẽa. Shi dai ne cazhirua cawade ni mi buru ewate Bé tru careba bua Béra to aba bua tewara waĩ ẽa bu ẽa.
